_comment: Rolling stock of Rodalies and Renfe regionals in Catalonia. Source: docs/research/catalonia-2026/02-rodalies-trains.md section 4 and the lead-researcher check of 2026-11-24. Every figure is unverified against primary pages unless a field says otherwise; null means unknown, never zero. Do not present usual_lines as fact for a given train: for R1-R8 there is no unit data from any public source, only 'series usually seen on this line'.
source: research report 02 section 4; series seen in service from Renfe flotaLD.json (field mat), 2026-11-24

series.step_free_note: high floor with steps; some units refitted for PMR

series.note: Couples to 2 or 3 units. The most numerous Barcelona series. Figures from search summaries of Wikipedia and rodalies.gencat.cat, not checked against primary pages.

series.seats_note: rodalies.gencat.cat: 128 per motor car, 188 per trailer (2x128 + 4x188 = 1008); unclear whether seats or places

more than 50 (2016 figure); current count unknown

series.correction: Earlier research said 'probably withdrawn in Catalonia'. That is wrong: five 470 units were in service on R15 and R17 on 2026-11-24 (flotaLD, field mat).
